{{Bad image|reason=Numerous images are photographs rather than scans}} The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the sixth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, ''[[S06|Pokémon: Advanced]]'', in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). In Region 1 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to [[VIZ Media]] season (which correspond to [[List of English opening themes|opening themes]]), rather than by standard [[season]]s (in the same way as on [[Pokémon.com]]). ==Single releases== Single releases of the series were released by [[VIZ Media|Viz Video]] and Ventura Distribution in 2004 and 2005 on both VHS and DVD format. However, each DVD volume contains five sequential episodes (the last two listed as "bonus episodes"), while the VHS volumes only contain the first three episodes of their corresponding DVD volume. The DVD volumes contain the entire season between them, but the VHS volumes are missing the episodes that the DVDs label "bonus episodes." There are two boxed sets each containing three DVD cases with one disc each. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs. ===Volume 1=== [[File:Pokemon Advanced Box 1.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon: Advanced - Volume 1]] Pokémon: Advanced - Volume 1 was released by [[VIZ Media]] on October 25, 2005. It contains three discs with 20 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMABS1. This box set includes two bonus videos: "Pokémon Trading Card Game: Rise to the Top" and "The Power of Pokémon". "Pokémon Trading Card Game: Rise to the Top" is a short promotional video celebrating the {{TCG|2004 World Championships}}, while "The Power of Pokémon" shows footage of the 2004 World Championships set to a song. {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Hoenn}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Hoenn}}; {{roundy|10px}}" !
